verdict.rationale: Elicit's column/extraction-table feature lets analysts pull the same data point (e.g. study type, outcome) from many papers into one table, which indirectly supports comparing findings across sources rather than getting one unqualified answer, and Systematic Reviews aggregate multiple papers into a report. However, there is no explicit feature or documentation describing detection or visualization of agreement/disagreement/conflicting findings across sources. Missing for 10: an explicit consensus-vs-conflict indicator or synthesis feature, and any hands-on evidence that Elicit actually surfaces disagreement between papers rather than just listing extracted data.
